challenge.better_approach: Considered running the outline check over 9adc6fddf185 so the whole gate passes: it ties the tooth to live ticket state again, so the next new lane reds it the same way. Considered a scratch ticket: the gate reads the live ticket store, so the subprocess would need every berth faked. Reading the lane's own finding is the smallest change.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the refusal names each finding by its judge in brackets. Measured 2026-11-17 in the refusal text; the tooth also checks the lane field, so a change in wording reds rather than passes.
challenge.prior_art: The tooth already reads g_open['lanes'][lane]; the narrowed check reuses that and the refusal's bracketed judge name, which _entry_gate already prints (measured: '[buildme_rides_the_outline_check]').
challenge.real_collision: CLAUDE.md: a deterministic red is fixed or carries a decision from Akien. This narrows a tooth to its subject; Akien approved it in chat 2026-11-17 and the answer is recorded as a question on the ticket.

answers.falsifier: Done when test_question.py reseals green with tooth 3 passing and its hollow reading still reds tooth 3 (reverting the questions lane makes the open case cross). Wrong intent if the narrowed tooth passes with the questions lane removed from inspect_entry.
answers.from_idea: none, because the red it fixes is recorded on cairn/tools/question/validations/test_question.json and Akien approved the fix in chat 2026-11-17
answers.how: In teeth_door step 3, read the refusal for the bracketed finding [buildme_has_no_open_questions] rather than requiring the whole BUILDME gate to pass for live ticket 9adc6fddf185: open, the lane is red and the refusal names that finding; answered, the lane reads none and no refusal names it. Reseal the proof.
answers.traces_to: Law 9 (red measures distance from the spec: this red measures an unrelated lane, the outline check added by ticket c66b25d122e6) and Law 3 (a tooth measures its own subject).
answers.what: Tooth 3 of cairn/tools/question/proofs/test_question.py measures only its own lane: an open question makes buildme_has_no_open_questions refuse the crossing, and once answered that lane no longer refuses.

bullets.text: A tooth that asserts a whole gate passes turns red whenever any lane is added; a lane tooth reads its own finding.
